parent_objective: audit contract-clean projection alternatives after M1074 fails only allowed-surface contract
blocked_by: M1074 closed-loop gates passed but the selected candidate changed disallowed parameter groups
invalidates: rerunning PPO before auditing contract-clean alternatives already produced by M1073

public_gates: M1075 must not use private holdout
M1075 must identify whether M1073 has an exact-pass contract-clean candidate worth full public gate
forbidden_shortcuts: do not ignore M1074 proof gate passes

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: separates M1074 contract artifact from proof washout and selects a cleaner M1073 candidate for full public gate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit/selection only; no training, no promotion, no full-gate pass claim
stop_condition: stop if no exact-pass contract-clean M1073 candidate exists
stop if selected candidate would require weakening allowed prefixes
stop if audit would use private holdout
fallback_plan: if contract-clean candidate exists, route it to full public gate
if no clean candidate exists, route to projection selector redesign
if exact/proof tradeoff is unclear, route to projection candidate matrix audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1074 failed only allowed-surface contract while closed-loop gates passed

hypothesis: M1073 produced at least one exact-pass contract-clean candidate that should be evaluated by the expanded full public gate before redesigning projection.
success_criteria: audit identifies selected candidate or explains why none exists
audit checks changed_parameter_names against allowed prefixes
audit routes to full public gate or selector redesign
no PPO actor training promotion or private holdout occurs
decision_rule: M1075 may only audit M1073 contract-clean alternatives and route the next gate. It cannot run PPO, train actor, promote, or use private holdout.
